card.name: Word ending after sub- or shutt-
card.fires_on: The word ending right after 'sub' or 'shutt', as in 'substandard', 'subculture', 'shuttled', 'shuttling' and 'shuttles'. It is strongest on 'standard' after 'sub'.

modes.label: sub- plus standard
modes.description: The word 'standard' completes 'substandard', meaning of poor quality.
modes.example: revealed sub<<standard>> Chinese construction in Angola.

modes.label: Ending of shuttle words
modes.description: The ending of 'shuttle' forms such as -led, -ling and -les after 'shutt'.
modes.example: The space shutt<<les>> fly no more.
